models.name: discussion_board_guests
models.description: Guest actor table for unauthenticated users identified by session tokens. This table represents guest users who interact with the system without formal authentication credentials, tracked through session tokens for continuity while maintaining the actor pattern consistent with other user types in the system.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: Unique session token for guest identification. Used to track guest users across requests without authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft-deleted. Nullable, as guests are not typically deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access without authentication credentials.

This table stores session records for guest (unauthenticated) users who access the discussion board without logging in. Guest sessions allow tracking of anonymous user activity while maintaining security through session tokens.

## Purpose:
- Track anonymous user sessions and activity
- Maintain session state without requiring authentication
- Support time-limited guest access to the platform

## Key Relationships:
- Belongs to guest users via `guest_id`
- Each guest can have multiple sessions over time
- Sessions are temporary and expire after a period of inactivity

## Security Considerations:
- Sessions expire after a predetermined time
- IP and referrer information is logged for security auditing
- No sensitive user data is stored beyond session metadata

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest user when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL the guest was accessing when the session started.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL showing how the guest arrived at the site.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: discussion_board_members
models.description: Member actor table storing authentication credentials and profile information for registered users who can create articles, comments, and request administrator privileges.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for login. Required field.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name (1-100 characters). Required field.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: User's biography text. Optional field.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: User's role: guest, member, admin, or superAdmin. Required field.

plainFields.name: is_banned
plainFields.description: Whether the member account is currently banned.

plainFields.name: ban_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for banning the member account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

This table tracks active login sessions for member users, storing JWT tokens and session metadata.
Sessions are created when members log in and invalidated when they log out or change their password.

Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity.

Relationships:
- Belongs to: discussion_board_members (member)
- Session management: Handles login/logout and password change invalidation

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for authentication. Short-lived token (15 minutes) used for API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for session continuation. Long-lived token (30 days) used to obtain new access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client when the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header value when the session was created.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string from the client browser.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created. Also serves as last activity timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires (30 days from created_at). Session becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: invalidated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was explicitly invalidated (logout or password change). Null if session is still valid.

models.name: discussion_board_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery with expiration. Tracks reset requests, validates tokens, and records when resets are completed. Provides security audit trail for password change operations.

## Business Purpose
- Enables secure password recovery for member accounts
- Validates reset tokens with expiration checking
- Records when password resets are completed
- Maintains audit trail for security compliance

## Key Relationships
- Belongs to discussion_board_members (member account)
- One member can have multiple password resets over time
- Used for recovery workflows, not日常 authentication

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token for authentication. Used to verify password reset requests securely.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration time for the password reset token. Tokens must be used before this time to be valid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password was successfully reset using this token. Null until reset is completed.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address where the password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL where the password reset request originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header from the password reset request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for password reset records.

models.name: discussion_board_super_admin_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for super admin account recovery with expiration.

This table stores secure password reset tokens for super administrators who need to recover their account access. Each token is tied to a specific super admin and has a defined expiration time for security purposes.

## Usage
- Super administrators can request password resets when they forget their credentials
- Tokens are generated with cryptographically secure random values
- Tokens expire after a defined period (typically 1 hour)
- Once used, tokens are invalidated to prevent reuse

## Security Considerations
- Tokens should be single-use and invalidated immediately after successful password reset
- Token generation should use cryptographically secure random values
- Expired tokens should be automatically cleaned up
- Multiple concurrent reset requests may be allowed but old tokens should be invalidated

foreignFields.name: super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Super admin account requesting password reset. {@link discussion_board_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure password reset token generated for authentication.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Tokens are valid until this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset record was deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_administrator_requests
models.description:
User applications for elevated administrator privileges with status tracking.

This table stores administrator privilege requests submitted by members who want to become administrators.
Each request includes a reason text explaining the user's qualification and motivation.

Key characteristics:
- Only members (regular users) can submit administrator requests
- Requests follow a status workflow: pending → approved or rejected
- Super administrators can approve requests to grant administrator privileges
- Self-protection prevents users from approving their own requests
- A user can have only one active (pending) request at a time
- All requests are visible to super administrators for review

Relationships:
- Belongs to discussion_board_members (the requesting user)
- Optionally processed by discussion_board_super_admins (the approving super admin)

foreignFields.name: submitter_member_id
foreignFields.description: User who submitted the administrator request. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: processed_by_super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Super administrator who processed the request (approval or rejection). {@link discussion_board_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: User's explanation for why they should become administrator. Must be non-empty.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the administrator request (pending, approved, or rejected).

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator request was submitted. Always required.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was processed (approved or rejected). Nullable if pending.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by super administrator when rejecting the request. Nullable for pending or approved requests.

models.name: discussion_board_ban_records
models.description: User banning actions with reason, timestamp, and status tracking. Records when users are banned by administrators, including ban duration and reasons. Banned users cannot log in but their existing content remains visible. This is a primary table with full CRUD operations for administrative workflows.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator who created this ban record. {@link discussion_board_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ban_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the user ban. Required field with detailed explanation from the administrator.

plainFields.name: unban_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for unban when user is unbanned. Optional field explaining why the ban was lifted.

plainFields.name: banned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban was created. Required field indicating when the user was banned.

plainFields.name: unbanned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user was unbanned. Optional field indicating when the ban was lifted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Standard field for tracking when this record was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Standard field for tracking when this record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Nullable field indicating when this record was soft deleted, if ever.
